plan.label: Lessons
plan.text: Kids' group lessons are for ages 7 to 14; kids under 7 go in smaller groups by ability. Kids must be potty trained.

plan.label: Bring
plan.text: A helmet for every child in a lesson: the ski school doesn't rent or lend them. Full-day kids' group lessons include lunch.

plan.label: Lift and rentals
plan.text: Not included in lessons; add them at a discount when you book a group lesson.

plan.label: Childcare
plan.text: Okemo Child Care Center takes 18 months to 4 years, full days only; reserve ahead. Drop-off 8 to 9:30 a.m. on weekends and holidays (8:30 to 9:30 midweek), pick-up 3 to 4 p.m.

plan.label: Parking
plan.text: Free. The Clock Tower lot usually fills by 8:30 a.m. on weekends and holidays; overflow lots at Jackson Gore have a free shuttle on weekends and holidays.

prices.label: Toddler and Twos childcare (18 to 36 months)
Ready for PreK childcare (37 to 59 months)
Giggle and Glide (24 to 48 months, about 1 hour on snow)

okemo.price_basis: Okemo's childcare page lists these for a full day; it doesn't say per child. Cancelling costs $75 with 72 hours' notice; no refund after that.
okemo.unpriced: Our reader can't open Okemo's ticket and lesson pages, so check live.

tubing.text: Snow tubing and the Timber Ripper mountain coaster: 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. on set dates, weather permitting.

getting_there: Car: about 4¾ hours from New York City and 4½ from Newark (Okemo's estimates).
Train: Amtrak's Ethan Allen Express runs from New York to Rutland, about 25 miles from Okemo; you'll need a car or taxi from there.
backup: Snowmaking covers 98% of Okemo's terrain, by its own count.
Indoors: Okemo's Spring House Pool and Fitness Center; check its hours on Okemo's hours page.
Weather and refunds: Okemo's policies page has the rules; we haven't read them yet, so check before you buy.

plan.label: Opening day
plan.text: Mount Snow's pages we read don't give a winter opening date yet; check its lift and terrain status before you drive.

plan.label: Lessons
plan.text: Kids' group lessons are for ages 3 to 14; kids under 7 go in smaller groups by ability. Kids must be potty trained.

plan.label: Bring
plan.text: A helmet for every child in a lesson: Mount Snow requires them. Full-day kids' group lessons include lunch when offered.

plan.label: Lift and rentals
plan.text: Not included in lessons; add them at a discount when you book a group lesson. Epic Pass holders save 20% on group lessons.

plan.label: Childcare
plan.text: Mount Snow Child Care takes 18 months to 4 years, Friday to Sunday plus Dec 26-31, 2026 and Feb 15-18, 2027 (the page omits the years; closed Christmas Day); reserve ahead. Drop-off 8:30 to 10 a.m., pick-up by 4:30 p.m.

plan.label: Parking
plan.text: Free in Lot D, the Tiered Lots and Lot E (overflow on busy days); paid preferred parking sits closest to the slopes. A free MOOver shuttle runs to the Clocktower in the main base area.

prices.label: Full day childcare (18 months to 4 years)
Half day childcare (ages 3 and 4, paired with a morning ski lesson)

mount-snow.price_basis: Mount Snow's childcare page lists these rates without saying per child. Cancel more than 48 hours ahead for a full refund; later, a single-day booking costs 50%.
mount-snow.unpriced: We haven't read Mount Snow's ticket and lesson prices, so check live.
getting_there: Car: about 4 hours from New York City (Mount Snow's estimate); the last stretch is 9 miles up Route 100 from Wilmington.
Train or bus: Amtrak's Vermonter and Greyhound stop in Brattleboro; Mount Snow says round-trip shuttles are available on request, so ask before you book.
backup: Snowmaking covers 83% of Mount Snow's terrain, by its own count.
Snow tubing: Mount Snow's tubing page showed no hours or dates when we read it; call 1-800-842-8062.
Weather and refunds: Mount Snow's policies page may cover them; we haven't read it, so check before you buy.

plan.text: Hunter lists kids' lessons for ages 3-4, 5-6 and 7-14. Child group lessons are for ages 7 to 14; younger kids go in smaller groups by ability. Kids must be potty trained.

plan.label: Opening day
plan.text: Windham's pages we read give no winter opening date yet, and its snow report showed 0 of 12 lifts open on Nov 15; check it before you drive.

plan.label: Tickets
plan.text: Windham is now called Windham Mountain Club, but its lift ticket page says lift tickets are open to the public. Numbers are limited and some dates sell out, so buy ahead; walk-up tickets cost the most that day.

plan.label: Kids 6 and under
plan.text: Their tickets are sold only in person, with a qualifying adult ticket or pass, and the child must be there.

plan.label: Lessons
plan.text: Daily kids' lessons are for ages 3 to 12, in three groups: age 3, ages 4-6 and ages 7-12. Kids must be fully potty trained: no diapers or pull-ups.

plan.label: Changes
plan.text: Full refund up to 14 days before your ski day; after that, no refunds. Date changes cost a fee and must be made by the day before.

plan.label: Childcare
plan.text: The Windham pages we read don't mention childcare; call (800) 754-9463 before you count on it.

plan.label: Parking
plan.text: Parking is free, Windham's FAQ says. It also mentions a shuttle between lots and valet parking on weekends and holidays (valet price not stated).

plan.label: Passes
plan.text: Windham no longer takes the Ikon Pass.

prices.label: Lift ticket, age 6 and under (in person only)
prices.value: $45 a ticket, plus a $5 card fee if you don't have a Windham card

prices.label: Snow tubing (from the Dec 19 tentative opening)
prices.value: $55 a ticket (one rider) for a 2-hour session

windham.price_basis: From Windham's lift ticket and tubing pages. Adult and older-child day prices change by date on Windham's calendar; we haven't read them. Taxes not stated.
windham.unpriced: We haven't read Windham's adult day prices or lesson prices, so check live.
getting_there: Car: just over 2 hours from New York City (Windham's estimate): I-87 to exit 21, then 23 miles on Route 23 West.
Bus: Adirondack Trailways runs from Port Authority to the Windham bus stop, Windham says; check trailways.com for times and fares.
Train: Amtrak from Penn Station to Hudson, then about 40 minutes by car; Windham suggests an Enterprise rental car that meets you at the station.
backup: Snow tubing: Windham's tubing park is set to open Dec 19, tentatively, with 2-hour sessions between 10 a.m. and 4 p.m. There's no age or height limit, but each rider must sit up alone in their own tube. Book ahead; it depends on the weather.
Snowmaking: the Windham pages we read don't give a snowmaking figure.

plan.label: Kids 6 and under
plan.text: Ski free. Pick up their ticket at a ticket window.

plan.label: Kids 12 and under
plan.text: Each adult 5-day-or-longer date-specific ticket gets one free kids' ticket for the same dates; not for tickets starting on peak days, K-Ticket vouchers or spring passes.

plan.label: Tickets
plan.text: Online only. Prices change by date and rise as your ski day gets closer, so buy ahead. Killington takes the Ikon Pass.

plan.label: Changes
plan.text: Cancel up to 10 a.m. on the ticket's date; you get a credit voucher, not cash.

plan.label: Lessons
plan.text: Ministars group lessons for ages 4 to 6, Youth Group Lessons for ages 7 to 15, and private lessons from age 3 (including 1-hour privates for ages 3 to 4). Kids' groups meet at the Ramshead Base Area; arrive 30 minutes early for tickets and rentals.

plan.label: Childcare
plan.text: Killington Child Care Center, in Ramshead Base Lodge, takes babies from 12 weeks. Book in the ChildPilot app or at 802-422-6222; each child's vaccination record is required. Full refund up to 7 days before; drop-off by 10 a.m.

plan.label: Parking
plan.text: Free at all five base lodges, with shuttles between lodges and lots from 30 minutes before lifts open until 5 p.m. Paid premium spots at K-1 and Snowshed.

prices.value: Free, plus a $6 One Pass card if your child doesn't have one

killington.price_basis: From Killington's winter 2026/27 lift ticket and tubing pages. Killington doesn't say whether tubing prices are per rider per session, and another line on its page says from $29 adult and $24 youth, so check at booking. Sessions are 1 hour; riders must be 36 inches tall; 6% Vermont sales tax extra. Its childcare and premium parking prices were last winter's, so we leave them out.
killington.unpriced: We haven't read Killington's day ticket prices for older kids and adults (they change by date), so check live.
getting_there: Car: Killington lists drive times from airports, not from NYC: about 2¼ hours from Albany and 2 hours 40 minutes from Hartford's Bradley airport.
Train: Amtrak runs daily from New York Penn Station through Albany to Rutland; from Rutland, The Bus runs hourly to the mountain, Killington says.

Fly: Rutland airport (about 35 minutes away) has Cape Air flights from Boston; Lebanon, NH (about 55 minutes) has two daily flights from White Plains. Uber and Lyft aren't reliable at Rutland, so book a ride ahead.
backup: Snowmaking: Killington started making snow on Oct 17 with 165 snow guns on five trails, two weeks earlier than last year, it said.
Snow tubing: scheduled Dec 18 to Mar 21 at the Clubhouse on East Mountain Road, Fridays 3 to 6 p.m. and weekends, plus holiday weeks.
Weather: lift tickets can be cancelled until 10 a.m. on the day, for a credit voucher.
